bm25.q: How many days a week can I work from home once my probation is over?
bm25.answer: During probation, remote work is limited to one day per week. [Meridian_Tech_Employee_Handbook, p.1]

bm25.q: What monthly allowance do remote workers get for internet?
bm25.answer: Remote workers receive an internet allowance of Rs 1,200 per month, paid with salary. [Meridian_Tech_Employee_Handbook, p.1]

bm25.q: How many leave days can be carried over to next year?
bm25.answer: Up to 10 unused days can be carried forward into the next calendar year; the rest lapse. [Meridian_Tech_Employee_Handbook, p.2]

bm25.q: When do I need a doctor's note for sick leave?
bm25.answer: Sick leave is 12 days per year. [Meridian_Tech_Employee_Handbook, p.2]

bm25.q: Who has to approve an expense above 25,000 rupees?
bm25.answer: Any single claim above Rs 25,000 needs approval from a director. [Meridian_Tech_Employee_Handbook, p.3]

bm25.q: In which months are performance reviews held?
bm25.answer: Performance and Conduct Performance reviews take place twice a year, in April and October, using a rating scale from 1 to 5. [Meridian_Tech_Employee_Handbook, p.4]

bm25.q: How quickly does the Internal Committee respond to a harassment complaint?
bm25.answer: Harassment complaints go to the Internal Committee, which acknowledges every complaint within 48 hours and concludes its inquiry within 90 days. [Meridian_Tech_Employee_Handbook, p.4]

bm25.q: What is the minimum length for a password?
bm25.answer: I could not find this in the uploaded documents.

bm25.q: How long is an account locked after too many wrong sign-ins?
bm25.answer: Accounts are locked for 15 minutes after 5 failed sign-in attempts. [Meridian_Tech_Information_Security_Policy, p.1]

bm25.q: What encryption standard must be used for restricted data stored on disk?
bm25.answer: Restricted data must never be stored on laptops or USB drives. [Meridian_Tech_Information_Security_Policy, p.2]

bm25.q: How long do we keep customer logs before deleting them?
bm25.answer: Customer logs are retained for 13 months and then deleted. [Meridian_Tech_Information_Security_Policy, p.2]

bm25.q: Within what time must a security incident be reported?
bm25.answer: Incident Response Any suspected security incident must be reported to security@meridiantech.example within 1 hour of discovery. [Meridian_Tech_Information_Security_Policy, p.3]

bm25.q: How soon must critical security patches be installed on laptops?
bm25.answer: Critical security patches must be installed within 48 hours. [Meridian_Tech_Information_Security_Policy, p.4]

bm25.q: How often should I change the carbon block in the water purifier?
bm25.answer: A bad taste usually means the carbon block is exhausted. [AquaPure_W200_User_Manual, p.3]

bm25.q: What does error code E3 mean?
bm25.answer: Error code E3 indicates a fault in the TDS sensor. [AquaPure_W200_User_Manual, p.3]

bm25.q: What is the capacity of the purifier's storage tank?
bm25.answer: The storage tank holds 8 litres and the purified water flow rate is 2.5 litres per minute. [AquaPure_W200_User_Manual, p.1]
